thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>Group Members: Alena Chao and Natalie Wei</paragraph><paragraph>Website: <link href="https://cs182-ec-web.vercel.app/">https://cs182-ec-web.vercel.app/</link></paragraph><paragraph>Code: <link href="https://github.com/alenachao/cs182-ec">https://github.com/alenachao/cs182-ec</link> </paragraph><paragraph>We used Gemini 3.0 Pro to vibe code. After scraping the relevant posts using the Ed API, we asked it to "Code up a website to display the posts, specifically have a card for each post. Also, feel free to add other simple features if you are up for it." This gave us a fully working website with expandable cards, search bar, and tags. From there we prompted the agent to make specific refinement changes, mostly in the UI. Overall the model was able to quickly give a working baseline, from planning to implementation, without us having to write any code.</paragraph><paragraph/></document>
thread.document:
Group Members: Alena Chao and Natalie Wei

Website: https://cs182-ec-web.vercel.app/

Code: https://github.com/alenachao/cs182-ec 

We used Gemini 3.0 Pro to vibe code. After scraping the relevant posts using the Ed API, we asked it to "Code up a website to display the posts, specifically have a card for each post. Also, feel free to add other simple features if you are up for it." This gave us a fully working website with expandable cards, search bar, and tags. From there we prompted the agent to make specific refinement changes, mostly in the UI. Overall the model was able to quickly give a working baseline, from planning to implementation, without us having to write any code.
